review: Current-conversation implementation review of the actual world-153 request, not independent approval. Implements portable-insulation@1 with four-round study, shared optional owned target resolution, five paid crafting rounds, real bark/vine escrow, stationary cancellation and death release, persistent indivisible mantle identity, whole-item transfers, two-round repair with equal-mass scrap, bounded moisture/condition and multiplicative below-comfort cooling. New state activates only at installation. The private adapter reports actual owned garments and measurements. Relief uses the existing thermal-refuge source and shared cooldown; naming, manufacturing, ownership and learning grant no reward. Seven isolated unit cases passed; types, lint, architecture and build passed. Three actual Chromium frames were individually inspected for paid progress, wet/frayed wearing, remaining negative temperature change and the same ground item; the ground projection was corrected before this submission. These fixtures never enter ordinary context. Development-1 correctly failed exact reconstruction at round 86: the previous segment reader omitted operation cursors and re-resolved a reserved resource alias. The pinned experience-operation-replay-v1 store correction and shared browser/server cursor preparation preserve all original calls, events, checkpoints and cursor-free parts, while adding separate execution segments. A no-model cross-segment regression passes in both server and browser readers; removing cursors fails. The actual probe matched every world, event and cursor through all 447 original rounds. The initial policy, live controller, goals, budgets and seed are unchanged. The exact protected-path repair mapping is versioned and does not bypass full tests or hash comparisons. The coordinator must independently run the complete suite and reconstruct every retained prior round before activation. Internal developer model usage is unknown; the first failed validation remains budgeted and this corrected submission requires the next counted attempt.
